summary: זֵעָה is the sweat that forms on the body during exertion. In Genesis 3:19 the sweat on the man’s face shows how hard he must work for bread.

senses.definition: Moisture that forms on the skin during exertion.

evidence.note: בְּזֵעַת אַפֶּיךָ תֹּאכַל לֶחֶם means “by the sweat of your face you shall eat bread.” The face is where the sweat appears, and eating bread is the outcome of the labor.

phrases.gloss: by the sweat of your face
